newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL-Avesta Q1 profit seen down 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Avesta Q1 profit seen down 17 pct.

text.p: Swedish/British steel group Avesta Sheffield was seen posting a 17 percent fall in pre-tax profit to 189 million crowns for the first three months of its 1997/1998 fiscal year, a Reuter poll showed on Monday.
Forecasts from 12 analysts ranged from 60 million crowns to 309 million crowns. In the corresponding year-earlier period the company showed a profit of 228 million crowns.
For the full year, from April 1997 to March 1998, analysts expected the company's pre-tax profit to rise to 1.03 billion crowns from 124 million in 1996/1997.
Avesta Sheffield will release its first quarter earnings on August 21.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Aros, Carnegie, Den Norske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, Enskilda, Matteus, Myrberg & Wiklund, Nordiska, Swedbank and UBS.
